rationale: M59 (#825). Every line below is read off heritage-lines-825.kt. A kotlin supertype list wraps across lines, so the class header names only the FIRST entry: `Wrapped` opens on 9 and its list is written on 11-12, so all three heritage edges belong to 12 (`Base(x)` extends, `Marker`/`Second` implement). Live on kotlinx-coroutines TestScope.kt this is the shape `internal class TestScopeImpl(context: CoroutineContext) :` (183) / `AbstractCoroutine<Unit>(...), TestScope {` (184) — attributing to the header would send a tool to the class keyword for every wrapped parent. `Inline` pins the same-line case (no regression: 16 stays 16), and `Third` pins the interface rule (EVERY supertype of an interface is an extends, JLS-analogue of Kotlin's single ':' list). The forbid entries are the pre-fix positions: the class node's own line and the ':' line.

forbidRelationships.note: pre-fix: the class node starts at `class`, but `Base(x)` is written on 12
pre-fix: the `:` of the clause, but `Marker` is written on 12
pre-fix: the interface header, but `Marker` is written on 21
